name: bitbucket-mcp
description: The bitbucket-mcp server plus the pull-request workflow skill: review, comment, task, approve, create and merge Bitbucket Cloud pull requests.

bitbucket_default_workspace.title: Default workspace slug
bitbucket_default_workspace.description: The first URL segment of bitbucket.org/{workspace}/{repository} — a slug, not a display name. Set it and the workspace argument becomes optional on every tool.

bitbucket_email.title: Atlassian account e-mail
bitbucket_email.description: The simplest way in: fill this and the API token below. Leave both blank to sign in through the browser instead.

bitbucket_api_token.title: Atlassian API token
bitbucket_api_token.description: Paired with the e-mail above as Basic credentials. Needs read and write on both repository and pullrequest.

bitbucket_oauth_key.title: OAuth consumer key
bitbucket_oauth_key.description: For the browser sign-in flow instead: the key of an OAuth consumer you create in your own Bitbucket workspace. See the project README.

bitbucket_oauth_secret.title: OAuth consumer secret
bitbucket_oauth_secret.description: The secret matching the consumer key above.

bitbucket_access_token.title: Bitbucket access token
bitbucket_access_token.description: A ready-made token sent as Bearer. Takes precedence over everything else here and skips the sign-in flow entirely; usually only wanted in CI.
